title: Maintainability, Reliability and Ground Equipment
description: Maintainability, Reliability and Ground Equipment as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are maintenance tasks and their frequencies estimated for the installation?
Are reliability targets allocated to the installation?
Are ground equipment needs (for example jacks, rigs, servicing carts) identified?
Are line-replaceable items reachable without removing primary structure?
Are failure modes and their effects on maintenance assessed?
Are servicing points located for ground equipment access?
Are removal and installation times within the maintainability targets?
Are reliability predictions complete for the released design?
Are ground equipment interfaces defined and agreed?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
